raw.description: Hardcoded secret key used for JWT signing.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code can use the hardcoded secret key to forge JWT tokens.

raw.description: Lack of CSRF protection on file upload endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker can trick an authenticated user into uploading a file by making a request from a malicious site.

raw.description: Lack of CSRF protection on file listing endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker can trick an authenticated user into listing files by making a request from a malicious site.

raw.description: Lack of CSRF protection on file download endpoint.
raw.exploit: An attacker can trick an authenticated user into downloading a file by making a request from a malicious site.
An attacker with access to the source code can use the hardcoded credentials to access the database.

raw.description: Sensitive data (JWT token) stored in local storage.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the browser can retrieve the JWT token from local storage.

raw.description: Detailed error messages are logged to the console.
raw.exploit: An attacker can use error messages to gain insights into the application's structure and potential vulnerabilities.
